card.name: Leading digit of a threshold number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number (such as 1, 3 or 5) that begins a threshold, limit or multiple, often followed by more digits or a decimal. It appears in lab cutoffs and exposure multiples.

modes.label: Lab cutoffs
modes.description: First digit of a lab value limit such as neutrophil count or triglycerides.

modes.description: First digit of a times-the-dose or times-the-limit figure in animal or safety text.

modes.label: Device frequency
modes.description: A digit starting a frequency value in an imaging description.
